- Launcher desktop trash feedback now uses the active look.
- Removing an app from the home screen also removes it correctly from launcher folders.
- Release builds were fixed for full, lite, 32-bit and Play variants.
- YTXTube: with the comments panel open the video controls work again (the panel starts under the picture, so only the other sheets, speed and quality, hide the controls).
- YTXTube: the mini player shows the whole picture (a SurfaceView ignores the scale of the open / close morph and showed the top left quarter, big; the picture now goes through a TextureView whenever the player is not resting fully open).
- Toolkit > Resolution: the screen resolution and the density scaled together as shares of the phone's own screen (3/4, 2/3, 5/8, 1/2, 3/8, 1/3, 1/4) or your own values; the density is counted from the phone's own density, so everything keeps its size on the screen; unconfirmed changes go back after 15 seconds (a guard process in the shell, the countdown in the app, and a check at the next opening). Needs root or Shizuku.
